Description:en: Indicator reporting (MAL-001, MAL-016). Drug concepts whose orders count as first-line malaria treatment: artemether-lumefantrine and artesunate-amodiaquine. Injectable artesunate is not in the pinned dictionary.

Indicator reporting (RMNCAH-021). Drug concepts whose orders count as pneumonia treatment: amoxicillin, amoxicillin-clavulanate and co-trimoxazole, per the feasibility matrix. The national guideline list is still to be confirmed.
Indicator reporting (NCD-009). Drug concepts whose orders count as diabetes treatment: insulins, glimepiride, metformin and glibenclamide.
Indicator reporting (NCD-017). Drug concepts whose orders count as palliative strong-opioid treatment: fentanyl and morphine.

Indicator reporting (RMNCAH-018). Drug concepts whose orders count as oral rehydration for diarrhoea: ORS and oral rehydration therapy. Paediatric zinc is a separate formulary item and is not a member of this set.
